purpose: Multi-turn SFT conversation representation and assistant-only loss masking; diverse instructions. Not a matched-style training set.

selection.method: first 100 rows at offset 0 in official training split; no content filtering, rewriting or label flipping
selection.revision_verified_by: source API sha and viewer x-revision header

redistribution: Dataset card license applies; preserve attribution and upstream terms. No independent LICENSE file was provided by the dataset repository; declaration is evidence, not a legal guarantee for all upstream generated material.
warnings: Pilot training subset, not a benchmark or a safety evaluation.
Deterministic head selection is not representative sampling; independent held-out data must be designed later.
English external data needs larger pretrained base model; it does not replace controlled tiny-model teaching data.
